description: Ask for one firm all-in total for a stay from get_quote, for the connected traveller. Pass quote_id and option_token from get_quote, and the condition codes the traveller has agreed to in conditions_accepted. Read the codes and what they require with get_offer_rule_card. Only those inputs are read. Do not send a budget, another price or reasons; nothing else changes the result. Returns offer_id, status, total, conditions, expires_at and pay_url. status firm: the traveller pays at pay_url, signed in to the same account, and the conditions bind them. status standard with reason_code STANDARD_TERMS: pay_url is null and booking continues with start_booking at that total. Asking again about the same stay returns the same offer until it expires. Requires the traveller to connect their Tell & Go account.

conditions_accepted.description: Condition codes from the rule card the traveller explicitly agreed to.

option_token.description: option_token from get_quote, for that quote.
